scripts.start: bun run i18n:generate && SUBEYE_BUNDLE_SUFFIX=.dev expo start
scripts.ios: bun run i18n:generate && SUBEYE_BUNDLE_SUFFIX=.dev expo run:ios
scripts.android: bun run i18n:generate && SUBEYE_BUNDLE_SUFFIX=.dev expo run:android
scripts.build:ios:local: mkdir -p builds && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 EXPO_NO_CAPABILITY_SYNC=1 bunx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production --local --output builds/subeye-$(node -p "require('./app.json').expo.version")-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M).ipa
scripts.build:android:local: mkdir -p builds && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk} bunx eas-cli build --platform android --profile production --local --output builds/subeye-$(node -p "require('./app.json').expo.version")-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M).aab
scripts.build:android:apk:local: mkdir -p builds && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk} bunx eas-cli build --platform android --profile production-apk --local --output builds/subeye-$(node -p "require('./app.json').expo.version")-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M).apk
